issue_request: The Published/Persuasive tracker asked to fix rendering for Reference type elements that carry both ElementDefinition.type.profile and targetProfile, so the datatype profile name appears as well as the referenced target profile.
initial_application: No Jira-keyed HL7/fhir source commit was found. The Jira comment says the issue looked already fixed, and current HL7/fhir-ig-publisher rendering code handles both type.hasProfile() and type.hasTargetProfile().
additional_context: The original Zulip report identifies IG Publisher rendering as the broken surface; FHIR-I minutes approved the issue as Persuasive. Current core source actively defines profile and targetProfile separately for ElementDefinition.type.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No core source files were changed because the affected implementation is outside this checkout and the core conformance source is already correct.
